stories.title: Haben sie Trump über den Tisch gezogen? Dänen und Grönländer wundern sich über das neue Abkommen mit den USA

en.title: Did they pull the wool over Trump? Danes and Greenlanders wonder about the new agreement with the USA
en.summary: The US President sought control over Greenland and risked a major NATO crisis in the process. A new agreement has been reached that closely resembles an existing accord from 75 years ago.

stories.title: Ist es der eine Skandal zu viel? Die wichtigsten Fragen und Antworten zum Strafverfahren gegen Granit Xhaka

en.title: Is it one scandal too many? Key questions and answers on the criminal proceedings against Granit Xhaka
en.summary: The longtime captain of the national football team faces potential criminal charges regarding the acquisition of a forged COVID certificate. The 33-year-old has a history of polarizing controversies.

stories.title: Jürgen Klopp gebärdet sich als Fussballkanzler und wird für seine politischen Aussagen gelobt. Aber ist sein Verhalten auch klug?

en.title: Jürgen Klopp acts as a football chancellor and is praised for his political statements. But is his behavior wise?
en.summary: The national team coach addressed patriotism at a squad presentation in unusually statesmanlike fashion, departing from the approach of his predecessors.

stories.title: Ruderwettbewerbe an Olympia finden in einem Krokodilfluss statt. Kein Problem, sagen die Verantwortlichen

en.title: Rowing competitions at the Olympics will take place in a crocodile river. No problem, say those in charge
en.summary: Rowing events at the 2032 Australian Olympics will be held in the Fitzroy River, with organizers expressing confidence despite the location's wildlife concerns.

stories.title: Darüber spricht Nagoya: Will ich wirklich über 100 Jahre alt werden?

en.title: Nagoya discusses this: Do I really want to live over 100 years old?
en.summary: Japan now has around 100,000 centenarians and celebrates longevity as a cultural achievement. However, many Japanese citizens question whether they actually desire such extended lifespans.

stories.title: Das US-Militär braucht seine Arsenale im Iran-Krieg auf. Daraus ergibt sich für Chinas Staatsführung eine historische Chance. Wird sie Peking nutzen?

en.title: The US military depletes its arsenals in the Iran war. This creates a historic opportunity for China's leadership. Will Beijing seize it?
en.summary: Ahead of Xi Jinping's Washington visit, reports of US ammunition and capacity shortages concern American allies in Asia. The reported military depletion may provide strategic advantages to rival powers.

stories.title: London und sein Wexit – Die Preise in den Nobelvierteln sinken wegen des Exodus der Wohlhabenden. Und es könnte noch schlimmer kommen

en.title: London and its Wexit – Prices in upscale neighborhoods are falling due to the exodus of the wealthy. And it could get worse
en.summary: Wealthy individuals are departing London in a trend called wealth exit or Wexit, leaving visible impacts on the property market. Prices in affluent districts like Kensington have declined due to this migration.

stories.title: Die Huthi in Jemen wollen mehr sein als nur die Handlanger Teherans

en.title: The Houthis in Yemen want to be more than just Tehran's agents
en.summary: The Houthis have become a major regional power by controlling the Bab al-Mandab strait. Their alliance with a Somali terrorist group increases instability and risk in the Horn of Africa region.

stories.title: «Es ist der Beginn einer grossen Katastrophe» – Irans goldene Küsten färben sich schwarz

en.title: "It is the beginning of a great catastrophe" – Iran's golden coasts turn black
en.summary: Oil tankers and cargo ships damaged by Iranian and American forces are polluting Iran's southern coast, devastating local residents, hotel operators, and fishermen who depend on the sea for their livelihoods.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Zum Glück war Frankenstein ein Schweizer

en.title: COMMENTARY - Fortunately Frankenstein was a Swiss
en.summary: Switzerland must respond to concerns about artificial intelligence's dystopian potential by undertaking a major national initiative similar to past projects like the SBB or CERN to secure an independent future in AI development.

stories.title: L'accès à la Maison Blanche interdit à trois médias, conformément à une annonce de Donald Trump

en.title: White House access banned for three media outlets, in line with Donald Trump's announcement
en.summary: Journalists from CNN, MSNBC, and Politico were denied entry to the White House on Saturday after Trump announced the restriction the previous day. The measure has drawn widespread criticism as a threat to press freedom.

stories.title: Donald Trump interdit l'accès à la Maison Blanche aux médias CNN, MSNOW et Politico

en.title: Donald Trump bans White House access for CNN, MSNBC and Politico media
en.summary: Trump announced Friday that CNN, MSNBC, and Politico will be immediately barred from accessing the White House, escalating his confrontation with media outlets.

en.title: Latin American stocks fit well in today's market environment
en.summary: Stock exchanges in Brazil and Mexico, often overlooked by investors, are benefiting from rising commodity and energy prices.

en.title: Power, ambition and interest rates: The relationship status between Kevin Warsh and Donald Trump is complicated
en.summary: President Trump expected the new Federal Reserve chair to provide cheap money but received the opposite instead, yet Trump continues to handle the Fed chairman carefully.

stories.title: Die unerfüllten Wünsche des Philipp Navratil: Putin lässt den neuen Nestlé-Chef vom eigenen Bauernhof träumen

en.title: Philipp Navratil's unfulfilled wishes: Putin lets the new Nestlé CEO dream of his own farm
en.summary: Nestlé's new chief Philipp Navratil faces multiple challenges including contaminated baby formula and geopolitical pressures related to Vladimir Putin, complicating his efforts to revitalize the company.

en.title: Companies do not thrive everywhere – Switzerland offers good soil
en.summary: Switzerland's success in business can be attributed to favorable conditions that allow companies to flourish, explaining economic disparities between different countries.

stories.title: St. Moritzer Monopoly: Eine Engadiner Ikone kommt unter den Hammer – doch der neue Besitzer bleibt ein Phantom
